# Wang Shouren (Yangming)

*1472 – 1529 · Chinese · [Neo-Confucianism](../movements/neo-confucianism.md)*

Scholar, statesman and general, leading figure of the "school of mind" within [Neo-Confucianism](../movements/neo-confucianism.md), thinker of the unity of knowing and acting.
